svg.aria-label: Virtual nodes: server 0 and server 1 each appear three times on the ring (s0_0, s0_1, s0_2 and s1_0, s1_1, s1_2), so each owns several smaller arcs. Key k0 walks clockwise to s1_1 and is stored on server 1. With 100 virtual nodes the standard deviation of load is about 10% of the mean; with 200 it is about 5%.
svg.title: Virtual nodes on the hash ring
